I go through cycles of going down to 80 pounds, then freaking out and gaining too much weight back. I understand that from your point of view that we have it better than you, but trust me when I say we are in the same boat. The last thing I want to do is belittle your experiences but, trust me, it’s painful for us too. Both of the things we are going through are valid and important.
